content: Semantics of LinErrorResponse . responseError Each Lin slave has the ability to set an error bit in the response part of one specific LinUn- conditionalFrame in the event of errors occurring on frame level. The error bit is modeled by means of a reference to an ISignalTriggering in the role LinError- Response . responseError .
